custody_model: Custodial exchange-hosted staking for Canadian residents. Ndax's current User Agreement states users receive full rights, interests and title to Virtual Assets purchased on the platform, while assets left on-platform are custodied under Ndax and third-party custody arrangements. Current staking/risk disclosures state Ndax arranges staking or delegation through approved third-party validators.
yield_source: Ndax's current relationship and staking disclosures describe proof-of-stake validation through experienced third-party validators. User reward payments are determined by Ndax and may change, while current staking policy states reward estimates are not guaranteed and are paid only after Ndax receives rewards from successful validation activity.
risk_notes: Risks include third-party validator dependence, slashing, protocol/network failures, bonding/unbonding delays, variable reward rates, market volatility, platform/custody exposure and regulatory change. Current title/custody safeguards do not eliminate staking-specific loss or platform risk.

custody_model: Custodial exchange-hosted staking. Current VALR terms state staked assets may be transferred into a separate account for protocol facilitation on behalf of the eligible account holder, while rights, title and ownership remain with that account holder; the assets are held by VALR for the account holder and are not VALR property or subject to VALR creditor claims.
yield_source: Proof-of-stake protocol rewards generated through supported digital-asset networks. Current VALR terms state rewards may be earned after successful validation, are remitted according to VALR's applicable percentage, can be subject to staking fees/commissions and are not guaranteed.
risk_notes: Risks include market volatility, liquidity/unstaking delays, protocol and validator failures, slashing, changing rewards/commissions, platform downtime and operational or regulatory change. Express ownership/creditor language does not remove protocol or validator risk.
